answer: In a PoA network, each identity posts bonded collateral, while evidence of coordinated equivocation links their claims into one fault cluster: if k identities sign conflicting histories, the penalty grows as O(k^2), rather than linearly. Detection also applies asymmetric capital depreciation, so operating a sybil swarm creates an exponential multiplier in aggregate loss. Thus an orchard of aliases, even under ivory shielding, sends a ripple of correlated risk through the escrow.
